headline: A Hungarian car industry company must also absorb losses due to Chinese expansion
summary: Hungarian car company AutoWallis, listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange, is affected by the negative mood in the European car industry. The article cites Chinese expansion, shrinking margins and rising costs.
why: AutoWallis is a Hungarian car distributor and retailer, so it is exposed to new-car sales trends and competition from Chinese brands in Europe.
